'''Current tubes''' were devices used for transit in [[Coral City/Legends|Coral City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The tubes were filled with water and propelled individuals at speeds of up to 30 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|km/h]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
